posts.trend: Indian Woman Pays Rs 10 Lakh Monthly Rent For 2-Bedroom Apartment In New York City, Sparks Debate
posts.context: Landlords in prime Indian tech cities extract high rents with passive-aggressive politeness.
posts.angle: The sheer friendliness of a family landlord is the ultimate cover for economic extraction.
slides: Uncle, is baar appraisal thoda kam hua hai.

"Beta, standard ten percent toh badhna hi hai."
"Society maintenance has gone up."
"We have to paint the building next year."
"₹45,000 is very reasonable for this area."

"Accha, mom-dad kaise hain?"

He hasn't fixed the geyser since June.
posts.caption: Name the landlord who asks about your health only in the month of October. 📞
posts.rank_verdict: This is an exceptionally strong post, though the 'Uncle/Beta' framing slightly limits its immediate translation for non-Indian audiences.
